item.title: Brazil elections: Can Lula’s anti-poverty record win over voters?
item.description: In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is seeking a fourth and final term in the presidential election on October 4. In 2022, he made the fight against hunger and poverty a key campaign promise. Between 2023 and 2024, nearly nine million people were lifted out of poverty thanks to the government’s social and economic programs. The decline was particularly sharp in Brazil’s Northeast. A traditional stronghold for Lula, will the progress made in reducing poverty translate into stronger support for the current president? FRANCE 24's team on the ground reports. item.title: El banco central de Colombia aumenta la tasa de interés para frenar la inflación
item.description: El ente emisor colombiano subió, en 25 puntos base, la tasa de interés de referencia, con lo que pasa de 12% al 12,25%. De acuerdo con el gerente general de la institución, Leonardo Villar Gómez, el dato de inflación registrado en agosto motivó a la junta a efectuar cambios en la política monetaria. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Luis Méndez Urich
